# T-4: Separate retry handling

<!-- Auto-generated by `senti spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Classify semantic and non-semantic failures consistently, and defer exhausted semantic findings through flow-findings.json.

## Acceptance Criteria
- AI semantic FAIL consumes retry for review/gate phases that track retries.
- Mechanical, protocol, tooling, and AI output schema failures do not consume semantic retry.
- Exhausted semantic findings in the listed phases are recorded and exposed to acceptance-review context.
- Spec-review deferral reads the real spec-review.json semantic blocking records and assigns stable sourceFindingId values.

## Implementation Notes
Use existing flow-findings.js classes and review/gate retry hooks. Do not defer missing or invalid artifact states.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for retry counter updates, flow-findings append behavior, and context summary inclusion.
